title: CisLink: CRISPR-trained models of chromatin activity, 3D contact and cross-tissue co-activity linking noncoding variants and cis-regulatory elements to their target genes
description:
CisLink links noncoding variants and cis-regulatory elements to their target genes with two L2-regularized logistic regressions trained once on 10,250 CRISPR-tested element–gene pairs in K562 cells. CisLink-Extended is the full model for cell types with histone marks and their own Hi-C; CisLink-Base needs only accessibility and RNA. Both score element–gene pairs and every variant–gene pair. The package computes and harmonizes the input features from a cell type’s data and includes notebooks that reproduce the benchmarks.

Release 1.5.0 sets the recall-based thresholds as ENCODE-rE2G does, on cross-validated predictions for the K562 training pairs (CisLink-Extended 0.269 and CisLink-Base 0.230 at 70% recall); coefficients and scores are unchanged (see CHANGELOG.md). Roadmap activity reference: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23682289.
